crossRefs.note: Don’t throw me from your presence, and don’t take your Holy Spirit from me.
I will praise you, Lord my God, with my whole heart. I will glorify your name forever more.
For your loving kindness is great toward me. You have delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.
I will be his father, and he will be my son. If he commits iniquity, I will chasten him with the rod of men, and with…
but my loving kindness will not depart from him, as I took it from Saul, whom I put away before you.

translations.web: Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor his loving kindness from me.
translations.bsb: Blessed be God, who has not rejected my prayer or withheld from me His loving devotion!
translations.kjv: Blessed be God, which hath not turned away my prayer, nor his mercy
translations.asv: Blessed be God, Who hath not turned away my prayer, Nor his lovingkindness from me. Psalm 67 For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. A Psalm, a song.
